# Release timing

Status: **Built** · Section: Release pipeline · [All features](README.md)

## What is there

release.yml writes Workflow started/completed/duration

## What is missing

nothing. (Read back on v0.1.215: the notes say started 12:02:29Z, the same second GitHub recorded for the run's first job. The start is the earliest job start GitHub recorded for the run, with the first job's clock as the fallback; the duration is printed as HH:mm:ss.)
